subject: prd/plan-new
statement: If If a governing input changes between plan approval and projection (anchor moved, requirement superseded, doc re-merged), then the system shall detect the drift against the frozen plan's recorded references and halt with a defect naming the drifted references — never project a stale plan silently
fit_criterion: drift fixtures (moved anchor, superseded FR): projection refuses, names each drifted reference; unchanged inputs project normally
